author: Kənd Həyatı
description:
A true family tradition prepared the old-fashioned way 🌶️🍲 In this video, we make rustic beef casings filled with seasoned rice and meat, using traditional village cooking methods passed down through generations.

The filling cooks slowly inside the casings, becoming rich, juicy, and full of deep savory flavor. Every bite is hearty, satisfying, and packed with the warmth of homemade countryside cooking.

This dish reflects authentic village tradition — simple ingredients transformed through patience and skill. A comforting, flavorful meal often prepared for family gatherings and shared around a full table.
title: Rustic Beef Casings Filled with Rice & Meat | Family Tradition 🌶
